description: What a grammar node calls its inputs, and which Autark documents hold more than one view, as the node and the backend decide it. inputTableNames: the name a node's input on each circle is read by. oneView: a document, and what it is told, named by its key in autkGrammar.json ("oneView"), or null for a document that draws one view or none. Read by src/tests/contracts/autkGrammarCases.test.ts (inputTableName and autkOneViewProblem in contracts/autkGrammar.ts) and by backend/tests/test_agents/test_autk_grammar_cases.py (contracts.input_table_name and autk_one_view_problem, which the agents' document check uses).

oneView.name: a map alone is one view
a plot alone is one view
a list of one map is that map
a list of one plot is that plot
a document that only loads data draws no view
a map named null is no map
a map and a plot are two views
a list of maps and a plot are more than one view
